name: paytm-saathi
description: Paytm Saathi: AI companion for everyday financial decisions and emergencies (React + Node.js).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.reset: node -e "for (const f of ['saathi.sqlite3','saathi.sqlite3-shm','saathi.sqlite3-wal']) require('fs').rmSync('data/' + f, { force: true }); console.log('Saved data cleared.')"
